description: This file contains backend utility functions for object detection, including bounding box transformation, anchor shifting, image resizing, and a wrapper for tensorflow's map_fn, used within the keras_retinanet detection framework.

methods.name: bbox_transform_inv
methods.description: Applies regression deltas to bounding boxes, reversing normalization applied during training.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Generates shifted anchor boxes over a feature map based on shape and stride.

methods.name: map_fn
methods.description: Wrapper around TensorFlow's map_fn with support for different TensorFlow versions.

methods.name: resize_images
methods.description: Resizes images using specified interpolation method, wrapping TensorFlow's resize_images.
